"""Separate thermo source: ambient identities, disabled identity and solver gates."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import numpy as np

ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
OUT = HERE / "validation"
COEFFICIENTS = {"boundary_speed_thermo_closure": 1,
                "boundary_n_v2_cm3_kms2": "1320464.1871439987",
                "boundary_T_over_v2_K_per_kms2": "5.985098254241002"}


def read(path):return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)


def config(name, values):
    values = dict(values)
    values.update(threads=1, flux_variant="split_hlld", output_dir=OUT / name)
    path = OUT / f"{name}.cfg"
    path.write_text("".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in values.items()))
    return path, Path(values["output_dir"])


def run(name, values, executable):
    path, folder = config(name, values)
    subprocess.run([str(executable), "--config", str(path)], check=True, timeout=300)
    return folder


def identical(base, alternate):
    result = {"snapshots_identical": all(np.array_equal(np.load(p), np.load(alternate / p.name)) for p in base.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))}
    for name in ["probe.csv", "step_histogram.csv", "hlld_fallbacks.json"]:
        if (base / name).exists():result[name+"_identical"] = (base / name).read_bytes() == (alternate / name).read_bytes()
    a = json.loads((base / "statistics.json").read_text())
    b = json.loads((alternate / "statistics.json").read_text())
    keys = ["steps", "rejected_steps", "first_order_fallback_steps", "minimum_dt_day", "mean_dimensionless_divB", "max_dimensionless_divB", "weighted_dimensionless_divB"]
    result["physical_statistics_identical"] = all(a[key] == b[key] for key in keys)
    assert all(result.values()), (result, a, b)
    return result


def main():
    production = read(OUT / "hlld_thermo_coarse_cpu.cfg")
    evidence = {}
    for name, original in [("actual", production), ("nonzero_E", read(OUT / "inductive_global_gpu.cfg"))]:
        sample = dict(original)
        sample.update(COEFFICIENTS)
        sample.update(nr=6, ntheta=4, nphi=8, boundary_speed_offset_kms=37,
                      density_scale=1.4, temperature_scale=.8, magnetic_scale=1.2)
        path, _ = config(f"thermo_queries_{name}", sample)
        process = subprocess.run([str(HERE / "boundary_thermo_checks"), str(path)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        evidence[f"queries_{name}"] = json.loads(process.stdout)
        print(name, process.stdout, flush=True)
    disabled = read(OUT / "hlld_production_coarse_fp32.cfg")
    disabled.update(COEFFICIENTS)
    disabled["boundary_speed_thermo_closure"] = 0
    folder = run("hlld_thermo_off_coarse_fp32", disabled, HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_thermo")
    evidence["disabled_full_coarse"] = identical(OUT / "hlld_production_coarse_fp32", folder)
    print("Default-off full coarse identity passed", flush=True)
    tiny = read(OUT / "cme_tiny_fp32.cfg")
    tiny.update(COEFFICIENTS)
    cpu_tiny = run("hlld_thermo_cones_tiny_cpu", tiny, ROOT / "solver/thermo_cpu/mhd_solver_hlld_thermo.bin")
    gpu_tiny = run("hlld_thermo_cones_tiny_fp32", tiny, HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_thermo")
    a = np.load(sorted(cpu_tiny.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
    b = np.load(sorted(gpu_tiny.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
    evidence["closure_cones_tiny_field_Linf"] = (np.max(abs(a-b), axis=(0, 1, 2))/(np.max(abs(a), axis=(0, 1, 2))+1e-30)).tolist()
    assert max(evidence["closure_cones_tiny_field_Linf"]) < .003
    cpu = OUT / "hlld_thermo_coarse_cpu"
    if not (cpu / "statistics.json").exists():run("hlld_thermo_coarse_cpu", production, ROOT / "solver/thermo_cpu/mhd_solver_hlld_thermo.bin")
    fp64 = run("hlld_thermo_coarse_fp64", production, HERE / "mhd_cuda_hlld_thermo_reference")
    evidence["closure_full_coarse_fp64"] = identical(cpu, fp64)
    print("Closure CPU/GPU64 full coarse identity passed", flush=True)
    fp32 = run("hlld_thermo_coarse_fp32", production, HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld_thermo")
    dest = OUT / "hlld_thermo_coarse_precision_GTI.json"
    subprocess.run(["python", str(HERE.parent / "experiments/compare_variant.py"), str(cpu), str(fp32), str(dest)], check=True)
    comparison = json.loads(dest.read_text())["GTI_comparisons"]["PN_only"]["probes"]["comet"]
    evidence["closure_PN_precision"] = comparison
    for field in ["n_cm3", "speed_kms", "incident_flux_cm2_s"]:
        assert comparison[field]["maximum_abs_relative_change_within_observation_span"] < .01, comparison
    (OUT / "hlld_thermo_agreement_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":main()
